subject: SIG questionnaire intake — section triage & owner pins
summary: Initial SIG intake from NimbleHealth. Soojin triaged sections and proposed internal owners with a short timeline and evidence list. Follow-ups include prefilled matrix and evidence uploads to shared Drive.
messages:
From: Alice Mason <alice@nimblehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: NimbleHealth Security Team <security@nimblehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG request — initial intake (NimbleHealth)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is our SIG export (nimble_SIG_request_v1.zip) and a short questionnaire the security review board uses. We're kicking off vendor reviews for our Q3 integrations and would like Redwood's SIG completed by 2026-07-24 to keep the procurement timeline.

High level asks:
- Can you confirm a single point of contact for section assignment?
- Please indicate who on your side will own each section and provide evidence (docs, screenshots, report excerpts).
- If you already have a prefilled matrix or SOC 2 attachments we can consume, please upload to the shared Drive link below.

Drive: https://drive.nimblehealth.com/teams/sec/vendor-reviews/Redwood
HubSpot: HS-43092

Attachments: nimble_SIG_request_v1.zip (SIG CSV + questions)

Appreciate a quick reply with owners and any obvious blockers.

Best,
Alice
Alice Mason
Security Program Manager, NimbleHealth

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Mason <alice@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request — initial intake (NimbleHealth)

Alice — thanks for the intake and for the clear timeline. Team, looping you in to triage ownership. Below is a proposed split based on section headings in the CSV; please reply with confirmation or a one-line "can't pick up" by EOD tomorrow.

Proposed owners (first pass):
- Infrastructure & Physical Security: Marissa Cole (will include network diagram + datacenter attestations)
- Data Protection & Encryption: Diego Fernandez (key management notes + encryption-in-transit at rest summary)
- Access Control & Identity: Karthik Iyer (RBAC, SSO, onboarding/offboarding evidence)
- Change Management & Release Controls: Priya Natarajan (change logs + deployment gating screenshots)
- Vendor/Third-party Controls: Laura Bennett (vendor inventory + due diligence docs)

Planned deliverables and timing:
- 2026-07-16: internal confirmations and prefill of SIG_prefill_matrix.xlsx (attached)
- 2026-07-19: upload primary evidence to shared Drive (network_diagram_v2.pdf, SOC2-excerpt.pdf placeholder)
- 2026-07-22: final pass and submit to NimbleHealth Drive link

I attached a prefill of the SIG matrix that I started. We will use the shared Redwood folder and then grant NimbleHealth read access once the items are uploaded. If any section requires legal review (export controls, data residency exceptions), flag it ASAP so we can route.

Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: SIG request — initial intake (NimbleHealth)

Confirming I can own Infrastructure & Physical Security.

Notes: I will upload a network diagram (network_diagram_v2.pdf) and a short datacenter attestation. I also have the relevant SOC 2 control IDs mapped to the SIG questions; I'll attach a SOC2-excerpt.pdf (redacted) to the Drive. I don't anticipate legal review for these items.

Marissa

Subject: Internal: SIG owners — upload plan and quick blockers

Team — thanks for the quick confirmations. Action items: please drop primary evidence into the shared folder below and add a one-line summary in the SIG_prefill_matrix.xlsx under the "evidence_link" column. If you expect something to require redaction or legal review, add a comment in the matrix and @Legal (will route).

Shared Drive (Redwood): https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/FinOps/SIGs/NimbleHealth-intake
HubSpot: HS-43092 (recorded as "SIG intake received")

Short blockers I foresee:
- Diego: can you confirm whether KMS key IDs can be listed or if we need redacted screenshots?
- Karthik: please list the SSO audit retention window; Nimble often asks for retention durations explicitly.

Timeline reminder: submit by 2026-07-22 to leave two days for review on the Nimble side.

Thanks — S

Soojin — that's perfect, thanks for the clear owner map and timeline. We should be able to ingest the Drive uploads and will surface any clarifying questions by 2026-07-23. If you hit a blocker that affects the 07/22 submit date, please let us know and we'll accept a short extension.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
